_meta.description: Canonical entry point and navigation manifest for the professional Brain.

owner._comment: Intentionally empty until owner identity is explicitly supplied; do not infer personal information.

description: Permanent source-of-truth knowledge graph consumed by reasoning engines and output generators. Presentation documents are not stored here.

modules.name: identity
modules.description: North-star professional identity, positioning, values, trajectory, and description guardrails.
questionsAnswered: Who is this professional?
What problems do they solve?
How should an AI describe them accurately?

modules.name: experience
modules.description: Rich employment context, responsibilities, outcomes, lessons, and connections.
questionsAnswered: What did they own in a role?
Where was a capability demonstrated?
What role context supports a claim?

modules.name: achievements
modules.description: Atomic measurable outcomes with confidence and supporting evidence.
questionsAnswered: What measurable impact did they create?
What evidence supports a claim?

modules.name: projects
modules.description: Employer-independent initiatives, decisions, methods, results, and lessons.
questionsAnswered: How did they solve a specific problem?
What projects support a competency?

modules.name: skills
modules.description: Categorized capabilities grounded in experience, projects, and evidence.
questionsAnswered: What can they do?
How strong and current is a skill?
What evidence supports a skill?

modules.name: technologies
modules.description: Tools and platforms with proficiency, recency, use cases, and evidence.
questionsAnswered: Which technologies have they used?
How and where was a technology applied?

modules.name: industries
modules.description: Domain exposure, knowledge, affinity, and supporting work.
questionsAnswered: Which industries do they understand?
Which industries do they enjoy?

modules.name: voice
modules.description: Channel-independent writing style and AI editorial guardrails.
questionsAnswered: How should generated language sound?
What writing patterns must AI avoid?

modules.name: preferences
modules.description: Private career goals, constraints, targets, and deal breakers.
questionsAnswered: Which opportunities fit?
What constraints must an agent honor?

modules.name: management
modules.description: Leadership philosophy, behaviors, self-awareness, and evidence.
questionsAnswered: How do they lead, coach, decide, and delegate?
What environment enables their best leadership?

modules.name: interview-stories
modules.description: Reusable STAR narratives connected to competencies and evidence.
questionsAnswered: Which story demonstrates a competency?
How should a behavioral answer be grounded?

modules.name: writing
modules.description: Research, interviewing, story discovery, drafting, and review methodology.
questionsAnswered: How do they research and write?
How do they discover and structure stories?

modules.name: resume-strategy
modules.description: Policy for selecting Brain knowledge when deriving temporary ResumeDocument outputs.
questionsAnswered: Which verified knowledge should a resume emphasize?
How should selection change by target role?

relationships.description: The source provides evidence or substantiation for the target.
The source is an observable demonstration of the target capability.
The source is a component or scoped part of the target.
The source happened within the target experience or project context.
The source applied the target technology, skill, or method.
The source produced the target outcome or achievement.
The records are meaningfully associated when no narrower predicate applies.

instructions: Retrieve records from data arrays only; _template and _example are documentation.
Traverse relatedObjects using the relationship vocabulary.
Treat confidence and supporting evidence as claim constraints.
Never convert generated output into Brain source data without explicit verification.
